description: Known as The Liberator for his campaign for Catholic Emancipation.

name: Grace O'Malley
description: The Pirate Queen of Connacht who led a fleet of ships.

name: Brian Boru
description: High King of Ireland who ended the Uí Néill domination.

name: Constance Markievicz
description: First woman elected to the UK House of Commons and a leader in the Easter Rising.

name: Wolfe Tone
description: Founding father of Irish republicanism and leader of the 1798 Rebellion.

name: Michael Collins
description: Key figure in the struggle for Irish independence in the early 20th century.

name: St. Brigid
description: One of Ireland's patron saints and founder of the monastery at Kildare.

name: Charles Stewart Parnell
description: Powerful leader of the Irish Parliamentary Party and advocate for Home Rule.
